objective: Build a deterministic fail-closed Production Readiness Dossier that proves upstream gate lineage, inventories unresolved production prerequisites, and returns an explicit readiness verdict without activating Live, Auto, P24-B, or G13.
scope: Verify canonical upstream gate markers G0 through G12
Verify P23 is CANONICAL_COMPLETE with all P23 locks RELEASED
Inventory production prerequisites by lifecycle stage
Separate P24 phase-start authorization from first-Live Owner authorization
Separate pre-first-Live prerequisites from evidence that can only exist after Manual Live
Produce deterministic blocker sets and readiness verdict
Keep P24-B blocked while PRE_FIRST_LIVE prerequisites are unresolved; once resolved require the separate first-Live Owner Human Gate
Keep P24-G completion and G13 as phase-exit requirements rather than prerequisites for P24-B
out_of_scope: Selecting or accepting a production broker/exchange/provider
Setting monetary risk or leverage ceilings
dependencies: Owner phase authorization for P24 granted
tests: G0..G12 gate list/order and PASS markers are exact
P23 canonical closure marker is present
P24 phase authorization cannot count as first-Live authorization
PRE_FIRST_LIVE prerequisites fail closed until evidenced
P24-B cannot become READY_FOR_MANUAL_LIVE until PRE_FIRST_LIVE prerequisites and explicit first-Live Owner gate pass
LIVE_EXECUTION_VALIDATED cannot block entry to P24-B because its evidence is produced after Manual Live
P24-G kill-switch drill completion cannot block entry to P24-B
G13 remains a P24 exit gate and cannot block entry to P24-B
No circular stage dependency exists between P24-B and later P24/G13 evidence
P24-A evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: Any attempt to grant credentials/network/external-order authority fails closed
Any attempt to mark first-Live authorization true without explicit Owner gate evidence fails closed
Any attempt by P24-A to mark G13 approved fails closed
Any satisfied prerequisite without a non-empty evidence marker fails closed
Any missing/stale required upstream gate marker fails closed
No production activation is permitted by P24-A
rollback: Revert P24-A dossier/policy/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P23 remains CANONICAL_COMPLETE and Live/Auto remain DISABLED.
definition_of_done: Pre-first-Live, Owner-gate and P24-exit blocker classes are explicit and non-circular
Current blocker set and readiness verdict documented
P24-B remains blocked while PRE_FIRST_LIVE prerequisites are unresolved and otherwise remains behind separate first-Live Owner Human Gate
P24-G/G13 requirements do not incorrectly block P24-B
